mapper.insert: insert into sleep (sleep_id, member_no, record_date, sleep_hours, bedtime) values (#{sleep_id},#{member_no},#{record_date},#{sleep_hours},#{bedtime})
mapper.select: select nvl(count(*),0) from sleep where ${searchKey} like '%' || #{searchValue} || '%'

select * from ( select rownum rnum, data.* from( select sleep_id, member_no, record_date, sleep_hours, bedtime from sleep where ${searchKey} like '%' || #{searchValue} || '%' order by sleep_id desc) data)
where rnum>=#{start} and rnum<=#{end}
mapper.update: update sleep set sleep_id=#{sleep_id}, member_no=#{member_no}, record_date=#{record_date}, sleep_hours=#{sleep_hours}, bedtime=#{bedtime} where sleep_id=#{sleep_id}
